Jayson Tatum was COOKING, dropping 34 PTS, 8 REB & 9 AST in just THREE QUARTERS to lead the Boston Celtics to a dominant 119-80 victory over the Charlotte Hornets! Tatum knocked down 5 threes while shooting an efficient 9-16 from the field as Boston cruised to its seventh win of the season, improving to 7-2 overall and 2-0 in East Group C play.
